summary: First draft of the Switch v2 room template strangler-room.template.yaml (AGENTS_SPEC section 5)
prompt:
Write ONE new file at the project root: strangler-room.template.yaml — a Switch 0.31.0 *version 2* room template so Switch Console users can import the StranglerRoom 3-agent room in one click. Binding contract: docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md section 5 (also read sections 2-3 for the pipeline and docs/SWITCH_PROTOCOL.md section 7 for the template language). Do not modify any other file. The checker is scripts/validate_template.py (read it fully: it runs Switch's own template engine and lists every rule); it must print PASS with `.venv/bin/python scripts/validate_template.py --offline-only strangler-room.template.yaml` (0 lint errors AND 0 lint warnings, every scenario ok).

Requirements:
1. Top level ONLY `version: 2`, `params:`, `resources:` (optionally `form:`). Start with a short YAML comment header explaining what the template creates and that the three agents must already be registered (python -m agents.provision) because agent *resources* would need Switch agent management + a controller.
2. params:
   - `room_name`: type string, label 'Room name', description, default `strangler-migration`, pattern for a Mattermost channel slug, e.g. "[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}" (whole-value match; 'Not A Channel!' must be refused).
   - `bridge`: type bridge, label 'Messaging app', description, `default: [$first]`, `required: false`, `input: advanced`.
   - Declare NO other params unless every one is used (an unused param is a lint warning). Every `{placeholder}` used must be declared; builtins allowed: {$creator}, {$creator_email}, {$date}, {$timestamp}.
3. resources: exactly ONE resource, key `strangler_room`, `type: room`, no `if:`:
   - `name: "{room_name}"`, a one-line `description` (required), `bridge: "{bridge}"`, `channel_type: channel_public`.
   - `agents: [translator, fuzzer, cutover-gate]` — plain names of the already-registered custom agents, exactly in that order; NO aliases.
   - `users:` exactly `[{if: "{bridge}", value: ["{$creator}"]}, {value: []}]` (write it as a YAML block list of two mappings).
   - `instructions:` (block scalar, ~25-45 lines) describing the pipeline for agents and humans: the human lead asks the translator to `migrate /people/{user}/lists from legacy_openlibrary to FastAPI` (human-only); translator AST-introspects the legacy web.py lists module, deploys v1 FastAPI on :9002, writes the 'Parity & Cutover Audit Ledger' and hands off to the fuzzer; fuzzer runs a differential shadow campaign legacy :9001 vs modern :9002, records the 'Parity Audit Matrix', clusters divergences D-1..D-n and asks the human for decisions; the human replies to the translator `preserve D-.. and deprecate D-..` (human-only); translator patches v2, fuzzer re-verifies to 100% approved parity and hands off to the cutover gate; cutover-gate benchmarks legacy vs modern (p50/p95/p99), records the 'Cutover Scorecard' and asks for approval; the human replies `approve-cutover` (human-only) to flip the proxy :9000 to modern, or `rollback` (human-only); the translator then seals the hash-chained ledger. State the governance rule: migrate, preserve/deprecate, approve-cutover and rollback are HUMAN-ONLY — when an agent sends one, the receiving agent refuses with '🛑 Governance gate' and changes nothing; each agent document has a single writer (its creating agent) and the template deliberately does not pre-create them. In instructions and description name agents WITHOUT the @ character (mention hygiene) — do not write '@' anywhere in the file.
   - `kickoff:` (block scalar, a few lines) welcoming the room created {$date} for {$creator}, saying the three agents are here and how the human lead starts (send the translator the migrate command), naming agents WITHOUT '@' so the kickoff addresses NO agent and nobody.
   - NO `docs:` at all (the three agent-owned documents 'Parity & Cutover Audit Ledger', 'Parity Audit Matrix', 'Cutover Scorecard' must never be pre-created).
4. Keep it clean, commented, valid YAML; quote strings containing ': ' or starting with '{'.
